_what: HF dataset repo revisions the TRAIN mix was actually built from, read from this box's hub cache. `trainmix.py` made bare `load_dataset` calls, so the mix was reproducible only for as long as every upstream repo stayed still -- an unpinned training input behind a pinned model. Found by the pre-freeze over-fitting review (M1).
_how: cache refs/main (or refs/refs/convert/parquet for the mr-tydi parquet branch) under ~/.cache/huggingface/hub. Recorded WITHOUT re-downloading: these are the bytes the committed artifacts were built from, which is the only revision that can be honest.
_note: castorini/mr-tydi is loaded through its auto-converted parquet BRANCH, so its pin is that branch's commit, not main's.
